answer: As of November 20, 2025 the latest reported quarter was Ollie's fiscal Q2 2025 (13 weeks ended August 2, 2025), with net sales of USD 679.6 million (679,556 thousand; +17.5% y/y; 613 stores) [H01-E1][H01-E2].
